description:
Unit: U3
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u3-flatten-the-default-jido-test-tree

Outcome
Normal and Covenant-tagged executable tests live under their owning Jido.* namespace paths, and each component has a canonical behavior owner.

Requirements and decisions
R2, R4-R6, R8, R10, R12, R13, R16; KTD3, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8, KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/jido/core_contract/**; test/jido/ai/contract/**; test/jido/**; Covenant-tagged tests; test/contracts/coverage.json; test/quality/component_proof.yml; and active consumers for the default lane.

Implementation direction
Move each core_contract subtree to its component namespace and AI contract families below specific AI owners. Rename executable modules to production Jido.* and local fixtures to Jido.Test.*. Resolve filename collisions by behavior and keep distinct proof. Preserve Covenant IDs, tags, counts, and mutation ownership. Register each component canonical behavior owner in component_proof.yml. Delete overlap only with the KTD6 proof ledger.

Acceptance
Default tests find all moved files. Covenant discovers every prior active obligation with 100 percent coverage. Active IDs and counts match baseline. Each component has one canonical behavior owner. No core_contract or broad AI contract path remains active.

Verification
mix test --seed 0 --warnings-as-errors
mix test.contracts
mix quality.contract
mix test test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
Default and Covenant proof pass from namespace-owned paths, canonical owners are registered, and U4 can start.
title: U3 Flatten the default Jido test tree
